title: The Nine Words on the Card
subtitle: 焦虑与心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 焦虑与心理（科学与技术·医学与健康科学）
meta: 主题语境：焦虑与心理（科学与技术·医学与健康科学）　|　核心词汇：anxiety　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 anxiety 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 my mother sat outside a clinic door with ① an anxiety she could not name, and she said later that the naming was the whole of it. There was ② anxiety in the house from the autumn of 1969 onwards, the ordinary kind that comes from money and goes when the money does; an anxiety, she said, is only a message that has arrived before its letter.

The ③ anxiety clinic was nine miles away and had one door and no name on it, and she walked past it four times before she went in. The doctor called it ④ an anxiety disorder and wrote the hour down, and said that was the useful part; every anxiety she had ever had, she told him, arrived at the same hour of the day. The doctor said an anxiety is the only illness that keeps its own appointment, and she said that was the first thing she had ever heard that made it sound like a person.

My grandmother had ⑤ anxieties, plural, which she listed on Sundays, nine of them, and crossed off six by Wednesday. The ⑥ anxiety, meaning the thing in the body and not the thing on the list, is nine parts chemical and one part story, the doctor said, and my mother said that was the first useful thing anybody had told her.

He gave her ⑦ anxiety tablets and a card with nine words on it, and she kept the card and threw the tablets away in 1973. By 1975 her  anxiety had moved, which is what happens, she said: it had gone out of the chest and into the hands, and she began to wash them.

The  anxiety I remember is the one she had on the ninth of March, which was the only one she ever spoke about at the time. An ⑧ anxiety, she said in 1981, is not the opposite of courage; it is the price of it, and the nine words on the card were the only thing anybody in that house was ever cured by.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 焦虑；不安（一次具体的担忧）
B. n. 焦虑（泛指这种情绪、状态）
C. n. （临床的）焦虑症；作为疾病的焦虑
D. n. （复数 anxieties）一件件让人焦虑的事
E. 固定搭配：anxiety disorder 焦虑症
F. 固定搭配：anxiety clinic 焦虑症门诊
G. 固定搭配：anxiety tablets 抗焦虑药片
H. n. 焦虑（抽象总称；泛指这种东西）

items.q: an anxiety she could not name
anxiety in the house from the autumn of 1969
The anxiety, meaning the thing in the body

answers.why: anxiety 意为“一次具体的担忧、焦虑”，1971 年母亲怀着一种她说不出名字的焦虑坐在诊所门外。
anxiety 意为“焦虑（泛指这种情绪）”，从 1969 年秋天起，屋里就有一种因钱而来、钱一到就走的寻常焦虑。
anxiety clinic 意为“焦虑症门诊”，那家诊所在九英里外，只有一扇门，门上没有名字。
anxiety disorder 意为“焦虑症”，医生管它叫焦虑症，并把那个钟点记了下来。
anxieties 为复数，意为“一件件让人焦虑的事”，祖母每周日列出九件，到周三划掉六件。
anxiety 意为“作为疾病的焦虑（临床的焦虑症）”，指身体里的那种，而不是清单上列出的那些事。
anxiety tablets 意为“抗焦虑药片”，医生给了她药片和一张写着九个词的卡片。
anxiety 为抽象总称，泛指“焦虑这种东西”，她说焦虑不是勇气的反面，而是它的代价。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年母亲坐在诊所门外，怀着一种她说不出名字的焦虑。（anxiety）
从 1969 年秋天起，屋里就有一种焦虑，是那种因钱而来、钱一到就走的寻常焦虑。（anxiety）
医生管它叫焦虑症，并把那个钟点记下来，说这才是有用的部分。（anxiety disorder）
祖母有一件件让人焦虑的事，是复数，她每周日列出来，一共九件，到周三划掉六件。（anxieties）
他给了她抗焦虑药片和一张写着九个词的卡片，她留下卡片，1973 年把药片扔了。（anxiety tablets）
1981 年她说，焦虑不是勇气的反面，而是它的代价。（anxiety）

The doctor called it an anxiety disorder and wrote the hour down, and said that was the useful part.
My grandmother had anxieties, plural, which she listed on Sundays, nine of them, and crossed off six by Wednesday.
He gave her anxiety tablets and a card with nine words on it, and she kept the card and threw the tablets away in 1973.
